summary: refactor(routing-ledger): address shotgun surgery on conn variable

delivery.outcome: Connection lifecycle is centralized in _with_conn(db_path, fn); callers only define the operation, so the shotgun-surgery smell on 'conn' no longer spans the module. Follow-up commit switches _with_conn to PEP 695 type parameters (ruff UP047).
nonGoals: Changing SQL, schema, transaction or staleness semantics

architecture.decision: Introduce _with_conn(db_path, fn) owning init_db+close; each public function passes its operation as a closure.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: Ledger-backed benchmark tests pass; conn lifecycle in one helper.
